## Description

Tier-2 suite failure in this module. Fix so the README full suite passes at phase head. Do not reopen done tasks.

## Approach

1. Reproduce with: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_discuss_skill.py -q -k plan_phase_opens_a_blocking_plan_review_question
2. Failures: test_plan_phase_opens_a_blocking_plan_review_question
3. Fix tests and/or product code as appropriate; keep changes on phase/tiered-verification worktree.
4. Also ensure worktree `.tier2/` is gitignored so tier-2 runs record a clean head SHA (not dirty).
record.subject: fix-test_discuss_skill
